title: Eyes on Sunrise | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched along the coveted shores of Scenic Highway 30A in Inlet Beach, this stunning seven-bedroom coastal retreat captures the essence of effortless luxury and relaxed Gulf living. Just a two-minute stroll from the sugar-white sands, the home offers sweeping Gulf views from balconies on every floor, inviting mornings with coffee in the sea breeze and evenings painted with brilliant sunsets. Designed for both comfort and connection, the spacious layout features elegant living areas, multiple kitchen spaces, and an elevator for seamless access throughout. With accommodations for up to 26, beautifully appointed bedrooms—including expansive bunk rooms and serene king suites—create the perfect setting for memorable family gatherings and group getaways. Outdoor living takes center stage with a private pool and spa, where days are spent basking in the Florida sunshine and nights unwind beneath the stars. A vibrant game room with shuffleboard, arcade games, and a bar provides endless entertainment, while thoughtful extras like a six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring 30A both easy and fun. Just moments from the charm of Alys Beach and the local dining and shopping of Inlet Beach, the home blends sophisticated coastal design with exceptional amenities, creating an inspiring seaside escape where every detail is curated for an unforgettable stay.
